title: AIAS AI Office Activation
purpose: Activate accountable AI governance only after the Engineering Intelligence Core dependency is operational.
scope: Dependency gate, charter, intelligence-case routing, decision rights, model cards, evaluation, risk, oversight and KPI accountability.

requirements.title: Dependency gate
requirements.statement: AI Office shall activate only when SYS-000012 is operational.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Complete charter
requirements.statement: AI Office shall declare mandate, accountability, decision rights, evidence, KPIs and escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Case ownership
requirements.statement: Engineering-intelligence governance cases shall route uniquely to AI Office.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Decision evidence
requirements.statement: AI governance decisions shall require model card, evaluation, risk assessment and human oversight plan.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Professional boundary
requirements.statement: AI Office shall not grant licensed professional engineering approval.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: AI Office activation shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
